featured_reviews.name: Om Kadam
featured_reviews.review_text:
My mother, who is 60 years old, visited Ayushakti Ayurved Health Centre in Dadar West for knee pain treatment. Their doctor told us that the fluid in her knee (joint effusion) would return to normal and the pain would go away after treatment. They charged around ₹70,000 and asked us to take X-rays before and after the treatment to show the “improvement.”

For one month, they advised her to stop eating non-veg food and even restricted some veg food without any reason or alternatives.How can patient eat moong all days?

After one month, my mother took another X-ray, but there was absolutely no improvement. We then decided to take a second opinion from an orthopedic doctor. After checking both the “before” and “after” X-rays, the doctor explained that the clinic had asked for different X-ray angles/views, which can naturally make the images look different even without any actual improvement. He said this is a common way to mislead patients.

The worst part was that after paying such a huge amount, we couldn’t even question them properly. Whenever we asked anything, they gave scripted answers like, “You have to trust our medication.”

In my personal experience, this treatment was a complete waste of money. If you have plenty of money, you can try it at your own risk. But if you don’t want to waste your hard-earned money, please think carefully before going ahead.

God bless you if you are reading this after already making the payment.
